description:
A customer, Sarah Jenkins, has contacted support because she accidentally placed an order using an old account ('sarah.old') but wants it associated with her main account ('sarah.jenkins').

Your task is to:
1. Reassign Order #1 from the customer 'sarah.old' to 'sarah.jenkins'.
2. Block the 'sarah.old' account to prevent future use (do NOT delete it, just block/disable it).

The admin interface is already open. You can find orders under Commerce > Orders and users under People.
